title: verbose next measures its exact undelivered-changes page on the same JSON basis as every other agent word
outcome: verbose next measures its exact undelivered-changes page on the same JSON basis as every other agent word
acceptance: Verbose next emitted compact application-receipt JSON (CLI --json and MCP payload) and rendered terminal text each stay below 12288 UTF-8 bytes with a large undelivered backlog; a fixture with at least 20 KiB of changes proves complete dense traversal with no lost or duplicated entries and preserves the exact staged page, delivery cursor and token. Non-advancing peek remains non-advancing.

completion.summary: Verbose next stays under 12288 on compact JSON and terminal text, pages 20 KiB of changes densely without losing or duplicating entries, and peek does not advance.
